Check: robots.txt is reachable at /robots.txt and returns 200
How to verify: Fetch https://example.com/robots.txt; check status in GSC > Settings > robots.txt report.

Check: robots.txt does not block important sections, CSS or JS
How to verify: Review Disallow rules; test key URLs with GSC URL Inspection and a crawler using robots.txt rules.

Check: XML sitemap is referenced in robots.txt
How to verify: Look for a Sitemap: line in robots.txt.

Check: XML sitemap(s) submitted in Search Console with no errors
How to verify: GSC > Sitemaps: status Success, discovered URL counts match expectations.

Check: Sitemaps only contain 200, indexable, canonical URLs
How to verify: Crawl the sitemap list mode in Screaming Frog or run sitemap_validator.py.

Check: No orphan pages (important pages have internal links)
How to verify: Compare crawl URLs vs sitemap/GA4 URLs; Screaming Frog 'Orphan URLs' report.

Check: Faceted navigation and URL parameters are controlled
How to verify: Crawl with parameters; check GSC Crawl stats for parameter URLs; review robots/canonical rules.

Check: Server responds quickly and reliably to Googlebot
How to verify: GSC > Settings > Crawl stats: average response time, host status.

Check: Pagination links are crawlable <a href> links
How to verify: Disable JS or inspect rendered HTML for real href links to page 2, 3, ...

Check: Important pages are indexed
How to verify: GSC > Pages report; URL Inspection on key templates.

Check: No accidental noindex on important pages
How to verify: Crawl and filter on meta robots and X-Robots-Tag containing noindex.

Check: Canonical tags are present, absolute and self-referencing on canonical pages
How to verify: Crawl and compare canonical vs page URL; check for relative or missing canonicals.

Check: Canonical targets return 200 and are indexable
How to verify: Crawl canonical targets; Screaming Frog 'Canonicals' tab.

Check: Duplicate content variants consolidated (http/https, www/non-www, trailing slash, case)
How to verify: Request each variant and confirm a single 301 to the preferred version.

Check: Thin, low-value or empty pages are noindexed or improved
How to verify: Crawl word count, GA4 engagement, GSC impressions per URL.

Check: Google-selected canonical matches user-declared canonical
How to verify: URL Inspection: 'User-declared canonical' vs 'Google-selected canonical'.

Check: Internal search result pages are not indexable
How to verify: Check /search?q= style URLs for noindex or robots disallow.

Check: Main content is present in the rendered HTML
How to verify: GSC URL Inspection > View crawled page > HTML; compare with browser.

Check: Critical content and links do not depend on user events
How to verify: Check that tabs, accordions and menus have content in the DOM on load.

Check: Title, meta description, canonical and robots are in the initial HTML
How to verify: View source (not inspect element) and confirm tags exist.

Check: JS and CSS files return 200 and are not blocked
How to verify: URL Inspection > More info > Page resources; crawler with JS rendering.

Check: Internal links use <a href> with real URLs
How to verify: Crawl with JS rendering; inspect link elements in templates.

Check: No reliance on URL fragments (#) for unique content
How to verify: Check SPA routing uses the History API with real paths.

Check: Server-side rendering or static generation for key templates
How to verify: Compare raw HTML vs rendered HTML word count for key templates.

Check: Soft 404s handled correctly in client-side apps
How to verify: Request a nonsense URL and confirm a real 404 status or noindex.

Check: Important pages are within 3 clicks of the homepage
How to verify: Crawler 'Crawl depth' report.

Check: Logical URL structure that mirrors the site hierarchy
How to verify: Review URL patterns per template (e.g. /services/seo/dubai/).

Check: Breadcrumbs present on deep templates (with BreadcrumbList schema)
How to verify: Check templates and Rich Results Test.

Check: Descriptive anchor text on internal links
How to verify: Crawler 'Inlinks' anchor text export; avoid 'click here'.

Check: No internal links to redirects or 4xx pages
How to verify: Crawl and filter internal links by status code 3xx/4xx.

Check: Key money pages receive the most internal links
How to verify: Compare unique inlinks per URL against business priorities.

Check: Hub/category pages link to all relevant children
How to verify: Manual template review; crawl graph visualisation.

Check: Navigation and footer links are crawlable and not bloated
How to verify: Count links per page; review nav markup.

Check: LCP is 2.5s or less at the 75th percentile
How to verify: GSC > Core Web Vitals; PageSpeed Insights field data (CrUX).

Check: INP is 200ms or less at the 75th percentile
How to verify: CrUX / PageSpeed Insights; Chrome DevTools Performance panel.

Check: CLS is 0.1 or less at the 75th percentile
How to verify: CrUX / PageSpeed Insights; Layout Shift regions in DevTools.

Check: LCP image is not lazy-loaded and is prioritised
How to verify: Check for loading=lazy on the LCP element; consider fetchpriority=high.

Check: Images are compressed, sized and served in modern formats
How to verify: Lighthouse 'Properly size images' and 'Serve images in next-gen formats'.

Check: Width and height (or aspect-ratio) set on images, ads and embeds
How to verify: Inspect markup; Lighthouse CLS diagnostics.

Check: Render-blocking CSS/JS minimised; third-party scripts audited
How to verify: Lighthouse opportunities; Coverage tab in DevTools.

Check: Server response time (TTFB) is under ~800ms
How to verify: PageSpeed Insights TTFB; WebPageTest.

Check: Site is responsive and uses a correct viewport meta tag
How to verify: Check for <meta name=viewport content='width=device-width, initial-scale=1'>.

Check: Mobile and desktop serve the same primary content
How to verify: Compare rendered mobile vs desktop HTML for key templates.

Check: Structured data, meta tags and links match on mobile
How to verify: URL Inspection with smartphone Googlebot.

Check: Tap targets and font sizes are usable
How to verify: Lighthouse accessibility/best practices; manual check on devices.

Check: No intrusive interstitials on landing
How to verify: Load key pages on a phone from a search result.

Check: RTL layouts render correctly for Arabic pages
How to verify: Test dir='rtl' pages on real devices and browsers.

Check: JSON-LD is valid and parses without errors
How to verify: Schema.org validator; validate_schema.py; Rich Results Test.

Check: Organization and WebSite schema on the homepage
How to verify: Inspect homepage JSON-LD.

Check: Template-appropriate types used (Product, Article, LocalBusiness, FAQPage, BreadcrumbList)
How to verify: Rich Results Test per template.

Check: Markup matches visible on-page content
How to verify: Manual comparison of schema values vs page text.

Check: Required and recommended properties are filled
How to verify: GSC Enhancements reports; validate_schema.py.

Check: No errors in Search Console enhancement reports
How to verify: GSC > Enhancements / Shopping / Merchant listings.

Check: hreflang annotations present for every language/region version
How to verify: Crawl hreflang; run hreflang_checker.py.

Check: All hreflang annotations have return links
How to verify: hreflang_checker.py 'missing return link' column.

Check: Each page includes a self-referencing hreflang
How to verify: Check that the page URL appears in its own hreflang set.

Check: Language and region codes are valid (ISO 639-1 + ISO 3166-1 Alpha-2)
How to verify: Validate codes; correct examples: en-gb, ar-sa, en-ae.

Check: x-default defined for language selector or global fallback
How to verify: Look for hreflang='x-default'.

Check: hreflang URLs are canonical, indexable and return 200
How to verify: hreflang_checker.py target status column; compare with canonicals.

Check: Content is actually localised (language, currency, phone, address)
How to verify: Manual review of AED vs SAR pricing, local contact details.

Check: No automatic IP-based redirects that block crawlers
How to verify: Request regional URLs with a US IP / Googlebot UA and confirm access.

Check: html lang and dir attributes are set correctly
How to verify: Inspect <html lang='ar-SA' dir='rtl'>.

Check: Permanent moves use 301 or 308
How to verify: status_code_checker.py; crawler response codes.

Check: No redirect chains longer than one hop
How to verify: status_code_checker.py 'hops' column.

Check: No redirect loops
How to verify: Crawler redirect chain report.

Check: Removed pages return 404 or 410 (not 200 or homepage redirect)
How to verify: Spot-check removed URLs; GSC Soft 404 report.

Check: Custom 404 page is helpful and returns a real 404 status
How to verify: Request a nonsense URL and check status and content.

Check: Migrations have a complete redirect map
How to verify: Crawl old URL list and confirm each 301s to the correct new URL.

Check: 5xx errors are monitored and rare
How to verify: GSC Crawl stats by response; server monitoring.

Check: Server logs available and include user agent, status, URL and timestamp
How to verify: Request access logs from hosting/CDN (Cloudflare, Akamai, Nginx).

Check: Googlebot hits verified via reverse DNS
How to verify: Reverse DNS to googlebot.com / google.com, then forward-confirm.

Check: Crawl budget is spent on important sections
How to verify: Group log hits by folder/template; compare with priority pages.

Check: Important pages are crawled regularly
How to verify: Find priority URLs with zero Googlebot hits in the last 30 days.

Check: Crawled 3xx/4xx/5xx URLs are identified and fixed
How to verify: Filter log hits by status code.

Check: AI and other crawlers are identified (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, etc.)
How to verify: Filter logs by known AI crawler user agents.

Check: Entire site served over HTTPS with a valid certificate
How to verify: Check certificate validity and expiry; SSL Labs test.

Check: HTTP redirects to HTTPS with a single 301
How to verify: Request http:// URLs and check the redirect.

Check: No mixed content
How to verify: Browser console; crawler 'Insecure content' report.

Check: HSTS header enabled
How to verify: Check Strict-Transport-Security response header.

Check: Canonicals, hreflang, sitemaps and internal links use HTTPS URLs
How to verify: Crawl and search for 'http://' in these elements.

Check: No hacked content, spam pages or security issues flagged
How to verify: GSC > Security & Manual Actions; site:example.com spam queries.
